_meta.about: English content. Same structure and ids as content/site.fr.json (the reference). Any missing key falls back to the French text. Values marked « TO BE COMPLETED (À COMPLÉTER) » are unknown and must be provided by Crispy Food Products. Arrays replace the French ones entirely: keep their length, order and data fields (id, model, price, image, indent) identical to French — `npm run content:check` verifies it. Phone numbers, social links and the WhatsApp number are not repeated here on purpose: they always come from the French file.

The information entered in the order form (name, phone, city, neighbourhood) is used only to prepare a WhatsApp message that you choose to send. It is not stored by the website.
This website does not use advertising cookies or third-party trackers.
For any request about your data: niyondikojoffreasjubu@gmail.com.
